name: shopify
description: Connector-owned Shopify Admin API parity ledger with a fixture-backed Shop stream, typed destructive REST delete actions, and critical blocked destructive dispositions for state-destroying official operations.

risk.read: Fixed Shopify Admin REST/GraphQL reads only; no raw query or arbitrary API passthrough.
risk.write: Typed reverse-ETL actions only; executable deletes and state-destroying blocked operation rows require `destructive` confirmation and preview approval before execution.
risk.approval: Reverse ETL remains plan -> preview -> explicit approval -> execute; fixture-only evidence is not certification.
